title: Getting started
summary: Your first hour in Overrank: the tutorial, your class, your first rifts, the forge and the first rank.

blocks.text: You start in The Threshold : your first dungeon, then a short tour of the city. Finishing it awakens you and gives the Awakened badge. You get a starter weapon.
blocks.html: You start in The Threshold: your first dungeon, then a short tour of the city. Finishing it awakens you and gives the Awakened badge. You get a starter weapon.

blocks.text: Every new awakened is a Human : no class, +8% to all stats and +10% XP, with the whole General skill tree open. Open the class window (status window, Change class ) to choose one. The first change of a profile is free; later changes cost shards. Not sure? Look at the class list and read the Difficulty and Role of each. Assassin , Tank , Mage and Support are good first picks.

blocks.text: Each level gives stat points (3 per level up to level 30, then 2, then 1) and one skill point . Put your stat points in the stats your class focuses on: see the 7 stats . Mistakes are not final: a stat reset costs 120 shards per point (500 at least).

blocks.text: Rifts open on the squares of the city 's quarters, grouped in four danger zones. Start in the Docks zone (low danger: Namsan, Mapo, the palace garden's square for new awakened) and take rank E rifts; the transit kiosks take you there for free: Rank E rift . Beat the guardian to close the rift. Bring friends: a party holds up to 4 and gives a bonus to XP.

blocks.text: Spend your shards at the market and at the forge . Open chests and kill elite monsters: they can drop gear. Collect your daily rewards and redeem the codes .
blocks.html:
• Spend your shards at the market and at the forge.
  • Open chests and kill elite monsters: they can drop gear.
  • Collect your daily rewards and redeem the codes.

blocks.text: At level 10 and 5 cleared dungeons you can ask the Awakened Registry for rank D. A re-evaluation is free, once a minute. Full road: Progression path .
blocks.html: At level 10 and 5 cleared dungeons you can ask the Awakened Registry for rank D. A re-evaluation is free, once a minute. Full road: Progression path.

blocks.text: Do not rush rifts far above your rank: the game refuses you if the gap is too big. Weaker monsters give less XP (−20% per rank below yours). Join a guild from rank D to unlock its perks. Check the odds hub before spending shards on random rolls.
blocks.html:
• Do not rush rifts far above your rank: the game refuses you if the gap is too big.
  • Weaker monsters give less XP (−20% per rank below yours).
  • Join a guild from rank D to unlock its perks.
  • Check the odds hub before spending shards on random rolls.
